targets.authors: Blais, André, Elisabeth Gidengil, Agnieszka Dobrzynska, Neil Nevitte and Richard Nadeau.
targets.title: Does the Local Candidate Matter? Candidate Effects in the Canadian Election of 2000.
targets.evidence_quote: Our replication effort is twofold: we replicate Blais et al.’s (2003) original analyses for the 2000 Canadian election and we extend them to encompass three additional elections.
targets.outcome_quote: Using the CES from 2000 to 2008, we replicate Blais et al.’s (2003) original findings and extend their analysis to include four elections in total.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly conclude that the original findings replicate across the election samples.

reasoning: Both a reconstruction of the original 2000 data analysis and tests in three different election samples are reported. Classified as replication because it explicitly tests external validity in those additional samples; the single original paper is counted once. Full PDF identity and authors verified, all six pages and references present.
